text: Disturbing Screams on the Holy Night
You came to investigate the Tower of Clamor that showed up\nout of nowhere. Some noise can be heard coming from above.\nGo to the rooftop to check it!
Some peppy monsters are making a lot of noise at the top of\nthe tower. The anti-Xmas energy waves seem to be coming from\nthem. Defeat Gegner to stop the energy waves!
Velly has mastered the song that counters anti-Xmas energy\nwaves. Shawle wants to come along too. Take them both to\nthe tower!
Velly's voice has successfully weakened the anti-Xmas energy\nwaves. Defeat Gegner to save Navida City!
